summary: Dominion Energy filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of two series of senior notes: 2026 Series B Senior Notes due November 15, 2029, and 2026 Series C Senior Notes due January 15, 2037. Coupon rates, principal amounts, and offering prices are left blank in this preliminary filing; interest on the Series B pays semi-annually beginning May 15, 2027, and the Series C beginning July 15, 2027. Notes are redeemable at any time at stated redemption prices, or at 101% upon a Tax Credit Event. Joint book-running managers are Goldman Sachs and Mizuho; settlement is expected on or about November 2026 through DTC book-entry. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
